title: Specimen sheet
summary: You asked for interior headers rebuilt from scratch: proprietary, uncluttered and nothing like the homepage hero. This option opens the page like a sheet from a drawing set. Your statement sits at the top, and below it the page's own shape is drawn large: five noisy lines settle into one clean voice. The four services are flagged on the drawing and repeated as the columns underneath.

reference.site: Linear (new Mobbin reference), built on round-1 A's head grammar with C's drawing discipline
reference.borrowed: Linear's structure: a quiet statement at the top, then one large 1px drawing as the subject of the page, labelled by short hairline leaders in small type. There is no photo and no plate.
reference.kelwin: This is the 'Specimen sheet' from DIRECTION-AC §5.3. The bar is hero X's 96px nav, solid graphite with nothing behind it: lockup, tracked caps with CAPABILITIES current (paper text plus a 1px underline on the hairline), the outlined AUDIT REQUEST ↗, and + marks where the hairline meets the margins. A's head grammar is set top-aligned: '■ Narrative Systems' with mono 'Capabilities / 01', the two-voice 'Decide what / the market hears.' at 96px across cols 1–9, the 48×2 rule, a 20px lede in cols 1–6, and a three-row facts ledger (Engagement · Output · Starts with) in cols 9–12, bottom-aligned with the lede. 'The System Audit' in that ledger is the header's quiet door: an underlined link with a drawn ↗ to /audit, so the red stays on the drawing. Linear's isometric stack becomes Kelwin's CONTOUR drawn across cols 1–12, 280px tall, inside a registration frame with no plate. Five jittery 1px lines enter at the left edge, narrow through a filter and leave as one clean line, and that line meets the frame at the red output tick. Linear's hairline leaders become four flags (01.1 Positioning · 01.2 Message matrix · 01.3 Sales language · 01.4 Proof & evidence). Each one stands on the bundle's top line at its station, so the leaders get longer as the bundle narrows and show the filtering. There is one dimension ('One voice') under the clean run and one title block (FIG. 1.1 · What the market hears · Settled · Specimen) in the frame's bottom-right corner. After a ruled cut, the body opens in the same head grammar as every home section ('■ What we install' with the '07 services' meta, the 64px two-voice statement, the red rule), and its four strips repeat the flag codes in the same code boxes, so the drawing is the map and the strips are its legend.

motion: entrance (≈1.5s, --ease-out): the nav hairline draws and the CAPABILITIES underline seats on it. The label fades in, then 'Decide what' and 'the market hears.' rise out of their masks 200ms apart. The red rule draws, and the lede and facts ledger fade up 12px. The specimen's registration marks fade in at its corners.

orchestrated moment, the morph (0.6–3.4s): the five lines plot left to right in their raw, noisy state (1.1s). A settle front then travels left to right over 1.9s using JS sample interpolation. Behind it the noise decays, high harmonics first, so the frequency settles before the amplitude does. The bundle narrows through the filter and leaves as one clean line. Each flag registers as the front reaches its station, 01.1 → 01.4: the leader draws up from the bundle, then the code and label fade in. The 'One voice' dimension draws as the clean run forms. The red output tick lands when the front meets the frame, and the title block fades in last.

body (from 2.3s, standing in for the scroll): the ruled cut draws, the '■ What we install' label row fades in, 'The story is not copy. / It's infrastructure.' rises, the rule draws, and the four strips cascade 01.1 → 01.4 as their hairlines draw down.
ambient: one loop. The clean run carries a quiet 3px tone with a slow phase drift (12s per cycle). The noise stays still.
interaction: kit hovers only (nav items lift to --fg, the AUDIT REQUEST border turns --fg with its ↗ nudging, and 'The System Audit' link's underline brightens with its ↗ nudging).

on the live site: the specimen plays once when 40% of it is visible (IntersectionObserver, no pin), and the body reveals on scroll. With reduced motion there is no .is-play, so KM.init draws the settled specimen synchronously and starts no loop or timer.
notes: The stage is 1396px: 96 nav, the head, a 280px specimen, a ruled cut, then the body's label row, the 64px statement, the rule and four strips (cropped after the strips). The body statement is 64px, the floor for statements, so the page keeps one big title. Strip copy is shortened from capability-data.tsx to two lines each. The four strips are the same four services the nav lists under CAP. 01 (01.1–01.4), cropped from 07. C quotas: 1 drawing, 4 callouts, 1 dimension, 1 title block (4 cells), 5 registration marks (2 on the nav hairline, 3 on the specimen frame, with the title block taking the fourth corner), about 16 annotation words, and mono only as single-line labels. Red appears only on the two label squares, the two rules and the output tick. The header has no red button: the nav keeps the outlined audit request and the facts ledger links 'The System Audit ↗' to /audit; the full red primary + 'Talk to the team' pair belongs to the page's closing decision panel (not shown). There is no logo geometry anywhere except the nav lockup. Known overlap: the specimen is the Narrative glyph from the nav drawn large, by design, and it shares the noise-to-one-line idea with the home page's operating-principle figure (different scale and composition). The other two options no longer repeat it: Y draws the narrative as one document (FOLIO), and Z has no drawing (the statement itself is annotated), so you are choosing between three different pictures. The static HTML holds the settled drawing, generated from the same KM.geo the animation uses.
addressed: 'Too similar to the homepage hero' → no film or photo. The title sits at the top of a plain graphite sheet, with the drawing below it.
'More proprietary' → the drawing is Narrative Systems' own shape (noise settling into one voice), the same glyph the nav uses for it, drawn large.
Your bias towards C, without the clutter → one drawing, four labels, one measurement and one small title block. There are no cells, coordinates or mono paragraphs.
One way to read it → title, then the drawing left to right (01.1 → 01.4), then the service columns, which carry the same codes.
Same family as the homepage → the first section below uses the home head grammar: red-square label, two-tone heading, red rule.
'Definitely not B' → nothing from B. The logo symbol appears only in the nav lockup.
